aiScreening.sectionDescription: Help HR teams save dozens of hours of manual interviews. Quickly filter out unqualified candidates with automated AI scoring.
aiScreening.feature1Description: AI conducts first-round voice interviews on behalf of HR with hundreds of candidates at the same time, without scheduling limits.
aiScreening.feature2Description: AI instantly extracts reports on professional ability, behavioral style, and culture fit for each candidate based on the JD.
aiScreening.feature3Description: The system analyzes response latency, scripted-reading tone, and unusual background audio to protect answer integrity.
aiScreening.candidate1Summary: Strong design fundamentals, solid product thinking, and confident, persuasive communication. Excellent fit for a dynamic product culture.
aiScreening.candidate1Highlight1: More than 3 years of hands-on experience building large-scale design systems.
aiScreening.candidate1Highlight2: Clearly explained a user-centered design process.
aiScreening.candidate1Highlight3: Started the interview slightly fast, then adjusted well.
aiScreening.candidate2Summary: Rich qualitative research experience. Strong in deep interviews and journey mapping, while quantitative analysis needs further support.
aiScreening.candidate2Highlight1: Completed more than 40 broad surveys and built 5 accurate personas.
aiScreening.candidate2Highlight2: Interacted naturally and responded flexibly to AI scenario questions.
aiScreening.candidate2Highlight3: Limited experience with large data analysis tools such as SQL or R.
aiScreening.candidate3Summary: Solid basic visual design skills, but limited UX analysis and collaboration experience with technical teams. The technical test result did not meet requirements.
aiScreening.candidate3Highlight1: Proficient with Figma and produces clean layout grids.
aiScreening.candidate3Highlight2: Not yet strong on responsive principles and complex UI state transitions.
aiScreening.candidate3Highlight3: Answers about resolving disagreements with developers were too general and lacked real examples.

candidatePractice.title: Practice smarter interviews with AI
candidatePractice.description: Reduce anxiety and take control of your tone and content. Practice in a professional simulation that feels like speaking with a real recruiter.
candidatePractice.feature1Description: Choose your target role (IT, Marketing, Sales...), and the AI assistant automatically adapts a deep Q&A scenario for that field.
candidatePractice.feature2Description: Analyze tone, speaking speed, wording, and answer content. Receive a detailed evaluation as soon as you finish.
candidatePractice.feature3Description: Access a free library of realistic scenario questions and tough interview prompts collected from leading technology and finance companies.
candidatePractice.adviceText: Slow down slightly when explaining complex technical topics to make your answer clearer.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Find answers about languages, setup, and enterprise policies here.
faq.q1: Does the platform support English interviews?
faq.a1: Yes. InterV AI assistant supports fully multilingual interviews, including English and Vietnamese. AI can recognize pronunciation, check grammar, and score professional vocabulary accurately.
faq.q2: Do candidates need to install software or extensions?
faq.a2: No installation is required. The platform runs directly on the web. Candidates only need to open a browser on desktop or mobile, grant microphone permission, and start the interview.
faq.q3: Can companies try the product for free?
faq.a3: Yes. We offer a free trial for companies to experience the full workflow: custom JDs, automated trial interviews for 10 candidates, ranking reports, and anti-cheating technology.

finalCta.title: Ready for the next step in hiring and your career?
finalCta.description: Try InterV intelligent interview assistant now. Practice free as an individual or request a custom demo for your company.

footer.description: A next-generation AI platform for interview practice and candidate evaluation. We help candidates advance their careers and help companies find better talent faster.

howItWorks.description: Start a mock interview or screen resumes in minutes with a streamlined workflow and an intelligent AI assistant.
howItWorks.step1Description: Choose a target field or upload a job description. The AI assistant instantly designs a matching deep interview question set.
howItWorks.step2Description: Check your microphone and start a browser-based voice interview directly with the AI assistant.
howItWorks.step3Description: Get instant analysis of speaking skills, confidence, answer improvements, and an AI evaluation score.

testimonials.title: What customers say about InterV
testimonials.description: Thousands of candidates have won their dream interviews, and many companies have successfully automated hiring workflows.
testimonials.quote1: After practicing three mock interviews with InterV AI assistant before the real interview, I stayed calm and answered difficult professional scenarios confidently enough to receive my dream offer.
testimonials.quote2: InterV helped our HR team reduce first-round interview time by more than 60% while still selecting high-quality candidates through highly accurate JD-match scoring.
testimonials.quote3: As an introvert, interviews used to scare me. Practicing privately with AI gave me specific feedback on repeated fillers, fast speaking speed, and helped me sound much more confident.
testimonials.quote4: HR used to need two weeks to call-screen 100 resumes. With 24/7 AI voice interviews, we now receive a detailed ranked candidate list with recordings in one afternoon.

who.title: Who is this platform for?
who.description: Whether you are a candidate looking for a breakthrough or a company optimizing talent operations, InterV has a focused solution for you.
who.candidateTitle: Want to feel confident in every interview?
who.candidateDescription: Practice unlimited 1-on-1 sessions with AI that mirrors your industry context. Get instant feedback on vocabulary, speaking speed, fluency, and delivery.
who.employerDescription: Automate first-round voice interviews with AI. Analyze culture fit, professional skills, and scoring reports to filter 90% of resumes faster.

whyAi.title: Stronger outcomes from the AI assistant
whyAi.description: Advanced deep-learning and natural-language processing algorithms deliver realistic and accurate evaluations.
whyAi.benefit1Description: Next-generation conversational AI asks and responds in realistic context instead of following rigid scripts.
whyAi.benefit2Description: Accurately evaluates professional vocabulary, speaking speed, filler words, tone, intonation, and confidence.
whyAi.benefit3Description: We protect 100% of candidate voice-call data and company hiring information under global data security standards.
